findings.title: JWT None Algorithm Bypass - Flag Disclosure
findings.description: The application accepts JWT tokens with 'alg: none', allowing authentication bypass. By forging an auth_token with user_type=admin and any user_id/username, an attacker can access any user's account. The flag user (user_id=10019) was discovered by fuzzing the /password/{username} endpoint, and its identity was impersonated via a forged none-algorithm JWT.
